$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 223. Its deliverable is 'an ADR adopting one reading, carrying its own Acceptance conditions and Confirmation (ADR-032)', and it states it does NOT ratify ADR-031 or ADR-033. The maintainer chose reading 3 (amend the condition, narrow and testable) with an expiry of two releases on 2026-09-26. C1-C4 pin the deliverable's shape: the ADR exists, is Proposed (acceptance is a human act, §68), carries both ADR-032 sections, states the reading's four mechanisms and the two-release expiry, and says plainly what the expiry does to v0.8.0. THE VACUITY THIS BAR IS BUILT AGAINST: an ADR that adopts reading 3 in its title and states no expiry, no scope and no check would satisfy 'an ADR exists'. C3 requires each mechanism by name. WHAT THIS BAR CANNOT CHECK: whether reading 3 is right. That is a ratification judgement.

covers.declared: an ADR (035) adopting reading 3 of the release condition, with its own Confirmation and Acceptance conditions, saying what happens to the current dependencies
covers.uncovered: implementing ADR-035's check (rules 1, 3, 4, 5 in conformance/skill.py), widening the index line's scope, and the first release under it. Those are ADR-035's own acceptance conditions 1-3.
covers.split_note: Declared before this bar was read. Issue 257 prepares v0.8.0 with a ratification record; the check that enforces that record and the widened dependency scope land with it, because they are tested by exactly that release.

criteria.$comment: C1 the ADR exists and is Proposed, not self-ratified
C3 each mechanism of reading 3 is stated, not only named: scope incl tools/ and .claude-plugin/, declared blocker, ratification record, the check, the two-release expiry
criteria.target: bash -c 'for p in "tools/" ".claude-plugin/" "RATIFICATION-vX.Y.Z.md" "conformance/skill.py" "at most two releases"; do grep -qF "$p" docs/adrs/035-a-release-may-depend-on-a-proposed-adr-only-on-declared-and-expiring-terms.md || exit 1; done'

criteria.$comment: C4 the consequence for v0.8.0 is stated, with the counts
criteria.target: bash -c 'grep -q "v0.8.0 cannot ship until ADR-029, ADR-031 and ADR-033" docs/adrs/035-a-release-may-depend-on-a-proposed-adr-only-on-declared-and-expiring-terms.md'

criteria.$comment: C5 the index and README count it; the count guard agrees
